name: #[Object]
doc: The #[Object] is used instead of object numbers or names in order to address an object.

name: $ (Dollar Sign)
doc: The $ (dollar sign) character is used to address variables using the command line.

name: % (Percent)
doc: The % [Percent] keyword is a helping keyword that can be used as a scaling operator.

name: * (Asterisk)
doc: The * [Asterisk] is a placeholder which is used to substitute any other character or characters in a name.

name: + (Plus)
doc: The + [Plus] keyword is a helping keyword that has various functions.

name: - (Minus)
doc: The - [Minus] keyword is used to remove objects from a list or to indicate negative values.

name: . (Dot)
doc: The dot is a separator which is used in fractional digits and hierarchic IDs of objects.

name: / (Slash)
doc: The slash character has two functions: It is used to set options during a command.

name: ; (Semicolon)
doc: The semicolon separates multiple commands.

name: <<< (GoFastBackward)
doc: The <<< [GoFastBackward] keyword is a playback keyword which is used to jump to the previous cue in a sequence, without using cue timing.

name: = (Equal)
doc: The = [Equal] character is used when assigning a value to an object setting.

name: >>> (GoFastForward)
doc: The >>> [GoFastForward] keyword is a playback keyword which is used to jump to the next cue in a sequence without using cue timing.

name: Absolute
doc: The Absolute keyword is used to address the absolute layer.

name: Acceleration
doc: The Acceleration keyword is used to set the acceleration curve of a step in the phaser.

name: Action
doc: The Action keyword is used to call functions that do not have a designated keyword.

name: ActivationGroup
doc: The ActivationGroup keyword represents attributes that are activated together.

name: Agenda
doc: The Agenda keyword represents the single agenda events.

name: Align
doc: The Align keyword is a function keyword which is used to toggle through the align modes of the attribute encoders.

name: AlignTransition
doc: The AlignTransition keyword is used to toggle between the align transition modes: AlignTransition Mode Index Number Linear 0 Sinus 1 Slow 2 Fast 3

name: Appearance
doc: The Appearance keyword is used to assign an appearance to an object.

name: Assign
doc: The Assign keyword is a function which is used to assign objects to other objects.

name: At
doc: The At keyword is a function keyword and a helping keyword at once.

name: Attribute
doc: The Attribute keyword is an object keyword which is used to set attributes of a fixture.

name: AutoCreate
doc: The AutoCreate keyword creates objects depending on predefined source objects.

name: AutoStore
doc: The AutoStore keyword is used to directly store presets in a fixture type.

name: Bitmap
doc: The Bitmap keyword allows you to use media files such as images or videos, also called bitmap generator objects, and map them to the selection of fixtures.

name: Black
doc: Black is a playback keyword that is used to temporarily override the master level to zero on executing objects.

name: Blind
doc: The Blind keyword is used to suppress the output of the live programmer.

name: Block
doc: Block is a function used to add data and prevent them from tracking.

name: BPM
doc: The BPM keyword is used to set the speed of a fixture selection or a speed master using the unit BPM.

name: Call
doc: The Call keyword is used to apply an object or its content.

name: Camera
doc: The Camera keyword selects a camera in the camera pool.

name: CancelSoftwareUpdate
doc: The CancelUpdateSoftware keyword is a function keyword which is used to cancel the running process of sending grandMA3 update files to other grandMA3 devices in the network.

name: Capture
doc: The Capture keyword is a command keyword which is used to activate the current output values of specified parameters.

name: ChangeDestination
doc: The ChangeDestination keyword is a function keyword used to change the current destination of the command line.

name: ChangeMulticastBase
doc: The ChangeMulticastBase keyword is a function keyword used to change the current address of the Multicas t Base.

name: Channel
doc: The Channel keyword is an object keyword used to select fixtures of the ID type Channel.

name: ChannelFunctionDefault
doc: The ChannelFunctionDefault keyword is used to set all attributes to the default value of the first channel function.

name: ChannelSet
doc: The ChannelSet keyword is used to take channel sets, such as gobos, actively into the programmer.

name: Chat
doc: The Chat keyword is used to send messages via the world server in chat channels that were already joined.

name: ChatJoin
doc: The ChatJoin keyword is used to join a chat channel.

name: ChatLeave
doc: The ChatLeave keyword is used to leave a chat channel.

name: CleanUp
doc: The CleanUp keyword is a command keyword that is used to delete objects that are not used and do not contain references in the show file.

name: Clear
doc: The Clear keyword is a function keyword which is used to clear the selection, active values, or the programmer.

name: ClearActive
doc: ​The ClearActive keyword is used to deactivate all values in the programmer.

name: ClearAll
doc: The ClearAll function clears the selection and discards all values in the programmer.

name: ClearSelection
doc: The ClearSelection keyword is a function keyword which is used to deselect the selected fixtures.

name: Clone
doc: Clone replicates data from one fixture or selection to another throughtout the show file.

name: Collect
doc: The Collect keyword is used to add objects of the same type to a collection.

name: Collection
doc: The Collection keyword is an object keyword used to represent the current collection of objects.

name: Color
doc: The Color keyword is an object keyword which is used, for example, to adjust the color of the color theme to your liking.

name: ColorDefinition
doc: The ColorDefinition keyword is an object keyword which is used, for example, to adjust the color defintion of the color theme to your liking.

name: ColorTheme
doc: ColorTheme is an object keyword which is used, for example, to adjust the color theme.

name: CommandDelay
doc: The CommandDelay sets the delay time when executing commands in a cue.

name: Configuration
doc: A configuration contains a set of different button, key, fader, and encoder functions.

name: Console
doc: The Console keyword is an object keyword which is used to address all grandMA3 consoles in the network.

name: Cook
doc: The Cook keyword is a command keyword which is used to concoct recipes of objects without accessing the editor.

name: Copy
doc: The Copy keyword is a function keyword which is used to create copies of an object.

name: CopyCrashLog
doc: CopyCrashLog is a function keyword that is used to copy crash logs into the crash logs folder in the gma3_library folder on any device.

name: Cue
doc: Important: Cue is the only object type that accepts numerical IDs as decimal fractions.

name: CueAbsolute
doc: CueAbsolute is a layer keyword.

name: CueDelay
doc: CueDelay can set both the indelay and the outdelay time of a cue.

name: CueFade
doc: CueFade can set both the infade and the outfade time of a cue.

name: CueInDelay
doc: CueInDelay sets the delay time of a cue.

name: CueInFade
doc: CueInFade sets the infade time of a cue.

name: CueOutDelays
doc: CueOutDelay sets the outdelay time of a cue.

name: CueOutFade
doc: CueOutFade sets the outfade time of a cue.

name: CueRelative
doc: CueRelative is a layer keyword.

name: CueUpdate
doc: CueUpdate keyword is an object keyword which addresses all cues that can be updated.

name: CurrentEnvironment
doc: The CurrentEnvironment keyword addresses the currently selected environment of the current user - Live or Preview.

name: CurrentUser
doc: CurrentUser represents the user that is currently logged in.

name: CurrentUserProfile
doc: The CurrentUserProfile keyword represents the profile of the current user.

name: Cut
doc: The Cut keyword is a function keyword used to specify the source objects for a two-step action.

name: DataPool
doc: The DataPool keyword is used to address a data pool or objects outside the data pool you are currently in.

name: Deactivate
doc: The Deactivate keyword deactivates active data in the programmer.

name: Deceleration
doc: The Deceleration keyword is used to set the deceleration curve of a step in the phaser.

name: Decimal16
doc: The Decimal16 keyword is used to set the values of a fixture selection using the 16bit hexadecimal notation.

name: Decimal24
doc: The Decimal24 keyword is used to set the values of a fixture selection using the 24bit decimal notation.

name: Decimal8
doc: The Decimal8 keyword is used to set the values of a fixture selection using the 8bit decimal notation.

name: Default
doc: The Default keyword is used to reset the attributes of your fixture selection to default values.

name: Delay
doc: Delay sets the delay time of an object.

name: Delete
doc: The Delete keyword is a function keyword which is used to remove data in a show file.

name: DeleteGlobalVariable
doc: The DeleteGlobalVariable keyword is used to delete global variables in a show.

name: DeleteOtherVersion
doc: The DeleteOtherVersion keyword is a function keyword that is used to delete the installation files of the software versions in a grandMA3 device.

name: DeleteUserVariable
doc: The DeleteUserVariable keyword is used to delete user-specific variables.

name: Disconnect
doc: The Disconnect keyword disconnects the station from session.

name: Dismiss
doc: The Dismiss keyword is used to throw stations out of your session.

name: Display
doc: Display is an object keyword which is used to manage the displays.

name: DMXAddress
doc: The DMXAddress keyword is used to access DMX addresses directly using an absolute numbering method.

name: DMXLayer
doc: DMXLayer is a layer keyword.

name: DMXReadout
doc: The DMXReadout keyword is used to set the readout of DMX values in the user profile.

name: DMXUniverse
doc: The DMXUniverse keyword is used to access DMX universes or all DMX channels of a universe.

name: DoubleSpeed
doc: The DoubleSpeed keyword is a playback keyword which is used to change the speed of the speed masters, presets, or sequences to double the speed.

name: Down
doc: The Down keyword is a function keyword which is used to address the subfixture within the main fixture.

name: Drive
doc: The Drive keyword is used to address physical drives, for instance, USB flash drives and the internal hard drive.

name: DropOwnership
doc: The DropOwnership keyword is used when a user wants to edit an object that is currently owned by a different user.

name: DumpLog
doc: DumpLog is a function keyword that is used to deposit the output of the system monitor in the form of a text file in case you should experience any inconsistencies or errors in the software.

name: Echo
doc: The Echo keyword is used to display feedback in the windows Command Line History and the System Monitor .

name: Edit
doc: Edit is a function keyword which is used to modify values.

name: EditRecipe
doc: The EditRecipe is a function keyword that enables the recipe editor.

name: EditSetting
doc: EditSetting is a function keyword which is used to modify the settings of an object.

name: Effect
doc: The Effect keyword is an object keyword which is used to call fixtures of the ID type Effect in the programmer.

name: Eject
doc: The Eject keyword is used to eject a USB flash drive.

name: EncoderBank
doc: The EncoderBank keyword is an object keyword which addresses encoder banks.

name: EncoderBar
doc: The EncoderBar keyword is an object keyword which is used to switch between the encoder bars.

name: EndIf
doc: EndIf is a helping keyword that indicates the end of an If statement.

name: Environment
doc: The Environment keyword is used to grant access to the two environments of the user profile - normal and preview.

name: Exchange
doc: The Exchange keyword is a function keyword used to swap places.

name: Executor
doc: The Executor keyword is an object keyword used as a control handle for other objects.

name: Export
doc: Export is a function keyword which is used to save objects from the current show file as a smaller file.

name: Extension
doc: The Extension keyword is an object keyword which is used to address all extensions in the network.

name: Extract
doc: The Extract keyword is a command keyword used to call the values of presets without references.

name: Fade
doc: The Fade keyword is a helping keyword which is used to indicate fade times.

name: FaderCrossFade
doc: The FaderCrossFade keyword represents the crossfade function of a sequence.

name: FaderCrossFadeA
doc: The FaderCrossFadeA keyword represents the crossfade A function of a sequence.

name: FaderCrossFadeB
doc: The FaderCrossFadeB keyword represents the crossfade B function of a sequence.

name: FaderMaster
doc: The FaderMaster keyword applies the Master function to a number of objects such as executors, sequences, groups, masters, and other.

name: FaderRate
doc: The FaderRate keyword applies the Rate function to a number of objects such as executors, sequences, groups, masters, presets, and other.

name: FaderSpeed
doc: The FaderSpeed keyword applies the Speed function to a number of objects such as executors, sequences, groups, masters, and other.

name: FaderTemp
doc: The FaderTemp keyword applies the Temp function to a number of objects such as executors, sequences, groups, masters, and other.

name: FaderTime
doc: The FaderTime keyword applies the Time function to a number of objects such as executors, sequences, groups, masters, and other.

name: FastSync
doc: The FastSync keyword is a playback keyword that is used to determine the starting point of the phaser.

name: FeatureGroup
doc: The FeatureGroup keyword is used to address feature groups.

name: Filter
doc: The Filter keyword is used to call a filter.

name: Fix
doc: Fix is a function keyword which is used to latch executors on a page.

name: Fixture
doc: The Fixture keyword is used as an object keyword to access fixtures that have a fixture ID.

name: FixtureClass
doc: FixtureClass is an object keyword which addresses the fixture classes of a show file.

name: FixtureLayer
doc: FixtureLayer is an object keyword which addresses the layers of fixtures in a show file.

name: FixtureType
doc: FixtureType is an object keyword which addresses the fixture types of a show file.

name: Flash
doc: The Flash keyword is a playback keyword which is used to temporarily overwrite master level in order to set it to full on executing objects without using times.

name: Flip
doc: The Flip keyword is used to access the different pan/tilt combinations that direct a moving head in the same direction.

name: Fog
doc: The Fog keyword is an object keyword which is used to call fixtures of the ID type Fog in the programmer.

name: Freeze
doc: Freeze is a function keyword which is used to change the priority of the programmer.

name: Full
doc: Full is a function keyword which is used to set the dimmer values to 100 %.

name: Gel
doc: The keyword Gel provides the opportunity to edit or apply swatch book colors using the command line.

name: Generator
doc: The Generator keyword is an object keyword which is used to address the Generator pool objects.

name: Generic
doc: The Generic keyword is an object keyword which is used to call fixtures of the ID type Generic in the programmer.

name: GetGlobalVariable
doc: The GetGlobalVariable keyword is used to display global variables along with their values in the command line history.

name: GetUserVariable
doc: The GetUserVariable keyword is used to display user-specific variables along with their values in the command line history.

name: Go+
doc: The Go+ keyword is a playback keyword and it operates as a start signal for commands to be executed.

name: Go-
doc: The Go- keyword is a playback keyword that is used to activate the previous cue.

name: GoboImage
doc: The keyword GoboImage is an object keyword.

name: Goto
doc: Goto is a function keyword that is used to jump in a list using the original cue timing of the cue where the values were initially stored.

name: Grid
doc: The Grid keyword is used to set the grid cursor or span a grid area in the selection grid window.

name: GridPosition
doc: GridPosition is a layer keyword which represents the xyz grid coordinates of fixtures at a time as values were set in attributes.

name: GridStore
doc: GridStore transfers grid positions of subfixtures to fixture types.

name: Group
doc: The Group keyword is an object type that contains a certain selection of fixtures in a specific order along with xyz-coordinates used in the Selection window .

name: HalfSpeed
doc: The HalfSpeed keyword is a playback keyword which is used to change the speed of the speed masters, presets, or sequences to half the speed.

name: Help
doc: Help is a function keyword which is used to open the Help pop-up for you to search for topics or to use the context sensitive help.

name: HelpKeyword
doc: HelpKeyword is a function keyword which is used to list all grandMA3 keywords.

name: HelpLua
doc: HelpLua is a function keyword which is used to export a list of all grandMA Lua functions.

name: Hex16
doc: The Hex16 keyword is used to set the values of a fixture selection using the 16bit hexadecimal notation.

name: Hex24
doc: The Hex24 keyword is used to set the values of a fixture selection using the 24bit hexadecimal notation.

name: Hex8
doc: The Hex8 keyword is used to set the values of a fixture selection using the 8bit hexadecimal notation.

name: Highlight
doc: The Highlight keyword is a playback keyword that is used to apply the defined highlight values on fixtures that are selected.

name: Hold
doc: The Hold keyword is a special value that prevents an MIB action while the dimmer is closed.

name: Houselights
doc: The Houselights keyword is an object keyword which is used to call fixtures of the ID type Houselights in the programmer.

name: Hz
doc: The Hz (Hertz) keyword is used to set the speed of a fixture selection or a speed master using the unit hertz.

name: If
doc: The If keyword is a function keyword which is used to deselect fixtures in a selection.

name: IfActive
doc: IfActive is a function keyword that selects fixtures with active values in the programmer.

name: IfOutput
doc: IfOutput is a function keyword that selects fixtures based on their current output.

name: IfProgrammer
doc: IfProgrammer is a function keyword that selects fixtures that contain values in the programmer.

name: Image
doc: The keyword Image is an object keyword.

name: Import
doc: Import is a function keyword that incorporates small portions of exported show file data, available as XML files, into the current show file.

name: Index
doc: Index keyword is a command keyword that addresses values where a property can have more than one value.

name: Insert
doc: The Insert keyword is a function keyword which is used to insert pool objects between two other and already occupied pool objects.

name: Integrate
doc: The Integrate keyword integrates step 1 of a preset into other steps of the programmer.

name: Interface
doc: Interface is an object keyword which is used to set the network interface using the command line.

name: Invert
doc: Invert is a function to invert the selection status of fixtures.

name: Invite
doc: Invite is a function keyword which is used to invite other stations into the session.

name: IP
doc: IP is an object keyword which is used to manage devices with IP addresses.

name: JoinSession
doc: JoinSession is a function keyword which is used to join a session.

name: Key
doc: The Key keyword is used to address the network keys.

name: Keyboard
doc: Keyboard is an object keyword which is used to change the language of the on-screen keyboard.

name: KeyboardShortcut
doc: The KeyboardShortcut keyword is an object keyword that is used to work with keyboard shortcuts using the command line.

name: Kill
doc: The Kill keyword is a function keyword that executes the Go+ function on sequences and presets and disables all other played back sequences and presets.

name: KnockIn
doc: KnockIn is used to take values that are located for example in sequences or presets actively into the programmer.

name: KnockOut
doc: The KnockOut keyword is used as a function and value keyword to: Knock out selections in the programmer Knock out active attributes in the programmer

name: Label
doc: The Label keyword is used to give objects a name.

name: Layout
doc: Layout is an object keyword representing a layout of fixtures and other objects.

name: Learn
doc: The Learn keyword is a playback keyword that is used to determine the starting point and the speed of a phaser at the same time.

name: LearnSpeed
doc: The LearnSpeed keyword is a playback keyword that is used to set the speed in phasers.

name: LeaveSession
doc: LeaveSession is a function keyword which is used to leave the session you are currently in.

name: Library
doc: Library is an object keyword that is used to access the corresponding library folder down to the root on the hard drive.

name: List
doc: The List keyword displays show data, including objects and their properties, in the command line history.

name: ListCrashLog
doc: ListCrashLog is a function keyword that is used to list all crash logs in the system monitor.

name: ListOwnership
doc: ListOwnership is used as a troubleshooting keyword in case of a multi-user access conflict.

name: ListReference
doc: ListReference is used to display references and/or dependencies in your show file.

name: Load
doc: The Load keyword is a playback keyword which is used to prepare an executor to jump to another cue rather than jumping to the next cue when a Go+ is performed on the executor.

name: Loaded
doc: The Loaded keyword is a function keyword which is used to simultaneously handle several cues in a sequence that are in the Load status.

name: LoadShow
doc: The LoadShow keyword is a function keyword that loads a show from the folders: shows, demo shows, or backup .

name: Locate
doc: The Locate keyword is a function keyword that is used to locate objects that are assigned to executors and also locate ojects in pools.

name: Lock
doc: The Lock keyword is a function keyword that locks objects.

name: LogIn
doc: The LogIn keyword is a function keyword to log in another user.

name: LogOut
doc: The LogOut keyword is a function keyword which is used to log out the user and change to guest user.

name: Lowlight
doc: The Lowlight keyword is a playback keyword that is used to apply the defined lowlight values in fixtures that are subselected when highlight is enabled.

name: Lua
doc: The Lua keyword is used to execute commands in the script language Lua.

name: LuaFile
doc: The LuaFile keyword is used to execute a Lua file directly without the need to import it into the grandMA3 show file.

name: Macro
doc: The Macro keyword is an object keyword which is used to access Macros.

name: MArker
doc: The MArker keyword is an object keyword that is used to select fixtures of the ID type MArker.

name: Master
doc: The Master keyword is an object keyword that is used to address the different master functions, e.g., for the selected sequence, grand masters, speed masters and playback masters.

name: MAtricks
doc: The MAtricks keyword behaves as an object type.

name: Measure
doc: The Measure keyword is used together with the phaser speed (speed layer) to define the length of time of a phaser.

name: Media
doc: The Media keyword is an object keyword which is used to call fixtures of the ID type Media in the programmer.

name: MemoryInfo
doc: The MemoryInfo keyword is a command keyword that is used to indicate how much memory is occupied.

name: Menu
doc: The Menu keyword is an object keyword which is used to address menus.

name: Mesh
doc: The Mesh keyword is an object keyword which is used to address meshes.

name: MessageCenter
doc: The MessgeCenter keyword is an object keyword which is used to address the message center.

name: Move
doc: The Move keyword is a function keyword which is used to move objects to another location giving them a new object ID.

name: Multipatch
doc: The Multipatch keyword is a keyword which is used to address the multipatch fixtures of a fixture.

name: MyRunningMacro
doc: The MyRunningMacro keyword addresses macro playbacks that were started by my user profile and are currently running.

name: MyRunningPlayback
doc: The MyRunningPlayback keyword addresses playbacks that were started by my user profile and that are currently playing back.

name: MyRunningPreset
doc: The MyRunningPreset keyword addresses preset playbacks that were started by my user profile and are currently running.

name: MyRunningSequence
doc: The MyRunningSequence keyword addresses sequence playbacks that were started by my user profile and are currently running.

name: MyRunningSoundFile
doc: The MyRunningSoundFile keyword addresses sound playbacks that were started by my user profile and are currently running.

name: MyRunningTimecode
doc: The MyRunningTimecode keyword addresses timecode playbacks that were started by my user profile and are currently running.

name: MyRunningTimer
doc: The MyRunningTimer keyword addresses timer playbacks that were started by my user profile and are currently running.

name: Natural
doc: The Natural keyword is used to set the values of a fixture selection using the notation that is defined as natural in the different attributes.

name: NDI
doc: The keyword NDI is an object keyword that addresses NDI streams within the NDI folder of the video pool.

name: NetworkNode
doc: The NetworkNode keyword is an object keyword which is used to display the grandMA3 nodes in the network.

name: NetworkSpeedTest
doc: The NetworkSpeedTest keyword is used to excute a test of the network connection in devices defined in the command.

name: NewShow
doc: The NewShow keyword is a function keyword that is used to create new shows.

name: Next
doc: If no fixtures are selected and the default keyword is Fixture, the Next keyword selects the fixture with the lowest fixture ID.

name: NextY
doc: The NextY keyword is a command keyword that is used to move the main selection from fixture to fixture on the y-axis.

name: NextZ
doc: The NextZ keyword is a command keyword that is used to move the main selection from fixture to fixture on the z-axis.

name: NonDim
doc: The NonDim keyword is an object keyword which is used to call fixtures of the ID type NonDim in the programmer.

name: Normal
doc: The Normal keyword is an object keyword which is used to set the dimmer of the fixtures to the defined normal value.

name: Note
doc: The Note keyword is used to add or edit a short note in an object.

name: NShot
doc: The NShot keyword is used to set the number of phaser cycles.

name: Off
doc: The Off keyword is used as a function keyword to: Stop an executor Knock out parameters in the programmer Knock out selections in the programmer Knock out active attributes in the programmer For information on how to assign executors see As

name: Offset
doc: The Offset keyword is a helping keyword that helps calculate the pan and tilt offset in fixtures.

name: onPC
doc: The onPC keyword is an object keyword which is used to display all onPC stations in the network.

name: Oops
doc: The Oops keyword is a function keyword which is used to cancel: The last action made in the command line; The last fixture selection; The last action made in the programmer.

name: OSC
doc: The OSC keyword represents the open sound control data.

name: OutputLayer
doc: OutputLayer is a layer keyword.

name: Page
doc: The Page keyword is an object keyword which is used to access pages.

name: Park
doc: The Park keyword is a command keyword which is used to prevent DMX channels of fixtures to change their value.

name: Part
doc: The Part keyword is an object keyword which is used to segment cues in parts.

name: Paste
doc: The Paste keyword pastes or moves previously cut or copied objects.

name: Patch
doc: The Patch keyword is used to edit the patch address of single fixtures or entire fixture selections.

name: Pause
doc: The Pause keyword is a playback keyword which is used to pause: Crossfades between steps and cues; Timecode shows; Macros.

name: Percent
doc: The Percent keyword is used to set the values of a fixture selection using the percent (%) notation.

name: PercentFine
doc: The PercentFine keyword is used to set the values of a fixture selection taking into consideration two decimal places.

name: Phase
doc: Phase is an object keyword that is used to set the Phase layer.

name: Physical
doc: The Physical keyword is used to set the physical values of a fixture selection using the Physical notation.

name: Plugin
doc: The Plugin keyword is an object keyword which is used to access plugins.

name: Preset
doc: With the Preset keyword, it is possible to: Select the fixtures stored in a preset; Apply the At function on the preset within the fixture or channel selection; Set a property in a preset.

name: PresetUpdate
doc: The PresetUpdate keyword is an object keyword that contains all presets that can be currently updated.

name: Press
doc: The Press keyword is used to simulate the pressed state of a key.

name: Preview
doc: The Preview keyword is used to toggle the preview mode.

name: Previous
doc: The Previous keyword has several functions: If no fixture is selected, the fixture with the highest ID number will be selected.

name: PreviousY
doc: The PreviousY keyword is a command keyword that is used to move the main selection from fixture to fixture back to the previous position on the y-axis.

name: PreviousZ
doc: The PreviousZ keyword is a command keyword that is used to move the main selection from fixture to fixture back to the previous position on the z-axis.

name: ProcessingUnit
doc: The ProcessingUnit keyword is an object keyword which is used to address the grandMA3 processing units in the network.

name: Programmer
doc: ​The Programmer keyword represents the programmer playback.

name: Property
doc: ​The Property keyword is an object keyword which is used to communicate with the console for you to set a specific property.

name: PSR
doc: The PSR keyword is an object keyword which is used to select fixtures of the ID type PSR in the programmer.

name: Pyro
doc: The Pyro keyword is an object keyword which is used to call fixtures of the ID type Pyro in the programmer.

name: Quickey
doc: The Quickey keyword is an object keyword that is used to address quickeys in the pool.

name: Rate1
doc: The Rate1 keyword is a playback keyword that is used to reset the rate of a phaser to 1:1.

name: RDM
doc: The keyword RDM is an object keyword that addresses RDM objects within the RDM folder.

name: Readout
doc: The Readout keyword is used to set the readout of fixtures in the usual notation.

name: RealtimeChannel
doc: The RealtimeChannel keyword is used to address realtime channels.

name: Reboot
doc: The Reboot keyword is a function keyword that is used to shut down the station in use and boot it up again.

name: Recast
doc: The Recast keyword is a command keyword which is used to update attributes that were added or removed in the presets.

name: Reconnect
doc: The Reconnect keyword takes the station that was previously disconnected back to session.

name: Record
doc: The Record keyword is used to record a timecode show using the command line.

name: Relative
doc: The Relative keyword is an object keyword which is used to set the relative layer.

name: Release
doc: The Release keyword enters release values in the programmer depending on attributes specified and the fixtures that were selected.

name: ReloadAllPlugins
doc: The ReloadAllPlugins keyword is a function keyword that is used to reload the content of the external Lua files.

name: ReloadUI
doc: The ReloadUI keyword is a function keyword that is used to refresh the user interface of the console.

name: Remote
doc: The Remote keyword is an object keyword that is used to access the remote input types.

name: RemoteCommand
doc: The RemoteCommand keyword remotely sends commands to other stations.

name: RemoteHID
doc: The RemoteHID keyword connects a mouse and/or an external keyboard with different stations.

name: Remove
doc: The Remove keyword enters remove values in the programmer depending on the attributes specified and the fixtures that were selected.

name: RenderQuality
doc: The RenderQuality keyword is an object keyword that is used to address the objects within the render qualities pool.

name: Reset
doc: The Reset keyword is a function keyword used to clear the settings of objects, for example the MAtricks.

name: Restart
doc: The Restart keyword is a function keyword that is used to restart the application.

name: ReSync
doc: The ReSync keyword is a playback keyword that is used to gradually synchronize phasers.

name: Root
doc: The Root keyword is an object keyword which is used to access the root in the object tree.

name: RunningMacro
doc: The RunningMacro keyword addresses macros that are playing back.

name: RunningPlayback
doc: The RunningPlayback keyword addresses all running playbacks.

name: RunningPreset
doc: T he RunningPreset keyword addresses presets that are playing back.

name: RunningSequence
doc: The RunningSequence keyword addresses sequences that are playing back.

name: RunningSoundFile
doc: The RunningSoundFile keyword addresses sounds that are playing back.

name: RunningTimecode
doc: The RunningTimecode keyword addresses timecodes that are playing back.

name: RunningTimer
doc: The RunningTimer keyword addresses running timers.

name: SaveShow
doc: The SaveShow keyword is a function keyword which is used to save the current show file.

name: ScreenConfiguration
doc: The ScreeConfiguration keyword is an object keyword that addresses the different screen configurations of a user profile.

name: ScreenContent
doc: The ScreeContent keyword is used to represent the windows of a display.

name: Scribble
doc: Scribbles are little drawings that are used as visualizations instead of labels.

name: Seconds
doc: The Seconds keyword is used to set the speed of a fixture selection using the unit seconds.

name: Select
doc: The Select keyword selects objects as default objects.

name: SelectFixtures
doc: The SelectFixtures keyword is a function keyword that is used to create selections of fixtures in the programmer.

name: Selection
doc: The Selection keyword is an object keyword that is used to represent the current selection of fixtures in the programmer.

name: SendMIDI
doc: The SendMIDI keyword is a command keyword that is used to output MIDI notes, MIDI control change messages, and MIDI program change messages.

name: SendMVR
doc: The keyword SendMVR can be used to commit and request MVR files, or to join and leave the connection to other devices during MVR-xchange.

name: SendOSC
doc: The SendOSC keyword is a command keyword that is used to send an OSC command.

name: Sequence
doc: The sequence keyword is an object keyword that is used to select sequences in the sequence pool.

name: Session
doc: The Session keyword is an object keyword which is used to add ress all sessions in the network.

name: Set
doc: The Set key word sets values to properties of objects.

name: SetGlobalVariable
doc: The SetGlobalVariable keyword is used to set global variables in a show.

name: SetUserVariable
doc: The SetUserVariable keyword is used to set user-specific variables.

name: Shape
doc: The Shape keyword is an object keyword that is used to access shapes in the shape pool.

name: Shuffle
doc: Shuffle is a command keyword which is used to shuffle the order of the fixture selection.

name: ShutDown
doc: The ShutDown keyword powers down the grandMA3 console or closes the grandMA3 onPC.

name: SnapDelay
doc: The SnapDelay keyword sets a snap time.

name: SoftwareImport
doc: The SoftwareImport keyword is a function keyword which is used to import installation packages of a grandMA3 installer permanently to the hard drive of your grandMA3 console or the grandMA3 onPC using a given path.

name: SoftwareUpdate
doc: The SoftwareUpdate keyword is a function keyword which is used to update the software of every MA device or program in the network.

name: Solo
doc: The Solo keyword is a function keyword which is used to set the intensity values of fixtures - that are not selected - to zero.

name: Sound
doc: The Sound keyword addresses sound objects in the sound pool.

name: SoundChannel
doc: The SoundChannel keyword represents sound codes in the attribute calculators.

name: SpecialExecutor
doc: The SpecialExecutor keyword addresses special executors.

name: Speed
doc: The Speed keyword is used to set the speed of phasers.

name: Speed1
doc: The Speed1 keyword is used to reset the speed to 60 BPM.

name: SpeedMaster
doc: The SpeedMaster is a layer keyword.

name: Stage
doc: The Stage keyword addresses stages in the 3D space.

name: Station
doc: The Station keyword is an object keyword which is used to address all stations in the network.

name: StationSettings
doc: StationSettings keyword is used to address settings of your station.

name: Step
doc: The Step keyword is a command keyword which is used to define the step of the At command.

name: Stomp
doc: The Stomp keyword is a command keyword which is used to stop a running phaser.

name: Store
doc: The Store keyword is a function keyword which is used to store objects in the show file.

name: Swap
doc: The Swap keyword is a playback keyword that starts the playback of a sequence and pulls down the dimmer of all other fixtures that are not part of the sequence or that are protected against Swap.

name: SwitchTograndMA2Software
doc: The SwitchTograndMA2Software keyword is a command keyword that is used to remotely switch to Mode2 on a grandMA3 station.

name: SwitchTograndMA3Software
doc: The SwitchTograndMA3Software keyword is a command keyword that is used to remotely switch to grandMA3 software on a grandMA3 station that is currently running in Mode2.

name: Tag
doc: The Tag keyword is a function keyword used to address tags.

name: Temp
doc: The Temp keyword is a function keyword that enables an executor as long as you hold the executor key.

name: Thru
doc: The Thru keyword indicates the range of objects or values.

name: Time
doc: The Time keyword is used to toggle the time overwrite function on sequences.

name: Timecode
doc: The Timecode keyword is an object keyword used to select the timecode by default.

name: TimecodeSlot
doc: The TimecodeSlot keyword is an object keyword which is used to address the timecode slots.

name: Timer
doc: Timer is an object keyword which is used to access the timer objects.

name: Toggle
doc: The Toggle keyword is a playback and a helping keyword that behaves as an On or Off keyword, depending on the on/off status of an object, function, or mode it is applied to.

name: Top
doc: The Top keyword is a playback keyword which is used to jump to the beginning of a cue list or to set a timecode marker at the beginning of a timecode show.

name: TopUp
doc: The TopUp keyword is a function keyword which is used to select the highest level in the hierarchy of multi-instance fixtures whenever subfixtures are selected.

name: Transition
doc: The Transition keyword is used to determine the length of the period in a step.

name: Type
doc: The Type keyword is used to address children of an object.

name: UIChannel
doc: The UIChannel is an object keyword which represents an attribute in the fixture sheet.

name: UIGridSelection
doc: UIGridSelection keyword is used by the system to hold information about which objects are selected in a grid window.

name: Unblock
doc: Unblock is a function that converts blocked values into tracking values in cues.

name: Unlock
doc: The Unlock keyword is a function keyword which is used to unlock objects that were previously locked.

name: Unpark
doc: The Unpark keyword is a command keyword which is used to release a parked DMX channel or universe.

name: Unpress
doc: The Unpress keyword is used to simulate the unpressed state of a key.

name: Up
doc: The Up keyword is a function keyword which is used to navigate upward in the fixture structure.

name: Update
doc: The Update keyword is a function keyword which is used to update values in their source objects.

name: UpdateContent
doc: The UpdateContent keyword is used to scan a media pool, for example images, and create XML files for media files.

name: User
doc: The User keyword is used to log in or to change the user settings.

name: User1
doc: The User1 keyword is a function keyword that toggles between the encoder bar and the Xkeys bar.

name: User2
doc: The User2 keyword is a function keyword that toggles between the encoder bar and the executor bar.

name: UserProfile
doc: The UserProfile keyword is an object keyword.

name: Version
doc: The Version keyword is a function keyword which is used to grant access to details of the version in the console or in the onPC software.

name: Video
doc: The Video keyword is an object keyword.

name: View
doc: The View keyword calls or stores views on a screen.

name: ViewButton
doc: The ViewButton keyword is an object keyword which is used to call or store the object assigned on the view button.

name: Width
doc: The Width keyword is used to determine the width incorporating transition of the entire step.

name: World
doc: The World keyword is an object keyword which is used to call worlds along with their filters, and limit the access to the parameters in the world.

name: Zero
doc: The keyword Zero is a helping keyword which is used to set the intensity of the dimmer to zero if fixtures or channels are selected.
